messages:
Hannah: Quick kickoff  \r SkyBridge x Redwood integration launch. Scope: 30m demo webinar, 1 technical benchmark blog, 1 marketplace listing. Target week: Oct 14.

Leo: Prefer morning slot 9am PT. Main narrative: "plug-in inference + predictable unit cost" but let's lean into a reproducible recipe.

Mina: Partner will provide a redacted perf spreadsheet and architecture SVG. Legal wants percent-only claims; we'll show relative charts and link to a reproducibility repo.

Omar: Routing: HubSpot registration -> SFDC queue "Partners/SkyBridge". UTM to use: `utm_source=skybridge&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=sb-rw-oct14`. Form fields: email, company, role, consent, region (optional).

SignupBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/sb-rw-oct14. Recording auto-upload to gdrive/marketing/partners/skybridge-oct14.

Hannah: Content plan: benchmark blog (author: Mina) with methods appendix + short how-to on marketplace that links to repo and integration guide. Landing CTAs: "Download guide" and "Request demo".

Leo: I'll handle slides and the live demo flow. Keep slides light, include 3 charts: percent cost delta, relative p95, and infra config summary. Draft due Wed.

Mina: I'll sanitize CSV and write methods blurb. If legal insists on more redaction we'll use percent bars only. Uploading to gdrive/partners/skybridge/benchmarks_redacted.csv by Tue.

Omar: SFDC mapping: add rule to assign domain @skybridge.io to SkyBridge AE; else PartnerOps. Tag leads with campaign=sb-rw-oct14 and lead_source=partner_webinar. I'll create mapping Wed.

Hannah: Promotion plan: 2 partner tweets, 1 LinkedIn long post from partner PM, and an email send to 9k dev list + partner list (approx 2k). Follow-ups at +24h and +72h linking to repo.

Leo: Rehearsal: Oct 12 9:00am PT. Will post runbook 48h prior.

Mina: I'll include a short reproducibility snippet in the blog: 
```bash
# quick reproduce
git clone https://github.com/redwood/repro-skybridge.git
cd repro-skybridge
./bench.sh --model redwood/opt-quant --seq 512 --iters 500
```

Hannah: Action items recap: Mina (bench + methods Tue), Leo (slides + runbook Wed), Omar (HubSpot + SFDC mapping Wed), Hannah (landing + promo copy Fri). Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
